title: CompactProductProperSupportLaws
statement: Fix the finite datum $P$, ring $A$ and field $k$ of [def-pur-conventions]. Use bounded constructible finite-Tor inputs [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], the compact exterior arrows and compactifications [def-pur-compact-product-arrows], the supported exterior arrow [def-pur-supported-exterior-product], and the canonical proper-support, shifted class-image, extension and excision arrows [def-pur-proper-support-compact-maps]. Define five universally quantified propositions: for separated finite-type $X,Y$ over $k$, every proper compactification of each, and every two admissible inputs $K,L$, the canonical compact exterior arrow is invertible; it is natural for arbitrary morphisms between four admissible inputs; for closed supports $Z\subset X$, $W\subset Y$ proper over $k$, $u_{Z\times W}\kappa^{Z,W}=\kappa_c(u_Z\otimes_A^Lu_W)$; for each integer $a$ and each supported morphism $C_i(A[0])\to K[a]$, its adjunction transpose followed by $u_Z$ is the canonical constant-section-unit class image; for every bounded-below extension $F$ on the compactification with specified restriction isomorphism $j^*F\cong K$, excision is invertible and $u_Z$ followed by the extension arrow equals inverse excision followed by forgetting support. Define CompactProductProperSupportLaws as their conjunction. The ordinary-site input predicate and supported coefficient unit use [def-pur-supported-class-geometry].
